rows.responsibility: Session-scoped navigation/composition coordinator: cancel-and-replace link resolution; route peer/message/thread/topic/forum/community/folder/settings/search; resolve voice chat/boost/collectible/conference links; active-chat history and next/previous; multi-window handoff; filters/layers/third-column/adaptive layout; media open/saving restrictions; call/report/passport; theme/background/story/preview/subsection state. Responsibilities must split across existing domain owners.
rows.state_machine: Resolve requests are cancel-and-replace; navigation is typed by SectionShow way/activation; active chat/filter/folder/forum/community/layer lifetimes are independently fenced; separate-window routing prefers/reuses an existing matching window; media/theme/story async state is guarded by request IDs/lifetimes.
rows.failure_cases: stale link resolve; wrong account/window; duplicate stack entries; opening restricted media externally; filter/folder/forum state leak; stale theme/story/call callback
rows.fabushi_target: Extend existing Navigation/Conversation/Search/Account/Window/Resource/Permissions/Calls/Settings/Theme/Story owners and canonical components; keep domain truth outside presentation.
rows.production_evidence: Canonical owner families exist; source responsibility remains mapped-open until exact shipping composition and focused tests demonstrate equivalence.
rows.test_evidence: Focused cancellation/navigation/security/error/a11y tests plus descendant exact-head Actions and packaged acceptance required.
